fields.description: Master switch. When off, nothing is sent to Medusa and inbound requests are accepted but ignored (HTTP 200, status "disabled") so the caller does not retry forever.
fields.label: Enable Sync

fields.description: Base URL of the Medusa backend, no trailing slash. e.g. https://admin.example.com
fields.label: Medusa URL

fields.description: Path on the Medusa backend that receives our outbound events.
fields.label: Medusa Inbound Path
Request Timeout (seconds)
fields.description: How long to wait for Medusa to respond before giving up (seconds).
Uncheck only for a self-signed staging certificate.
fields.label: Verify SSL

fields.description: Medusa signs requests TO this site with this secret. Must match the Medusa plugin's webhook_secret.
fields.label: Inbound Secret (Medusa → here)

fields.description: This site signs requests TO Medusa with this secret. Must match the Medusa plugin's frappe_to_medusa_secret.
fields.label: Outbound Secret (here → Medusa)

fields.description: Send on the background queue so a slow or down Medusa never blocks a user saving a document. Turn off only for debugging.
fields.label: Send in Background

fields.description: Attempts per event before it is parked as failed. Between attempts the row waits 30 s, then 120 s, 270 s … and a once-a-minute sweep re-queues it.
fields.label: Max Attempts

fields.description: Medusync Log rows older than this are deleted nightly. Default 180 days — comfortably past the three months needed to answer 'did this record ever sync, and what happened'. 0 keeps everything, but note these rows carry the synced payload.
fields.label: Log Retention (days)

fields.description: Store request and response bodies on the log row. Turn OFF on sites syncing personal data you do not want duplicated into logs.
fields.label: Log Payload Bodies
Inventory & Pricing (handler packs)
fields.description: Used by the commerce handler pack (site_config `medusync_handler_packs`). Ignored when that pack is not loaded.

fields.label: Inventory Source Warehouse
fields.description: Warehouse whose sellable stock (actual − reserved − safety stock) is pushed to Medusa. Stock in other warehouses is ignored.

fields.label: Selling Price List for Medusa
fields.description: Item Prices on this list become the Medusa base price. Blank = Standard Selling. Other selling lists sync as B2B tier prices when they carry a Medusa Customer Tier code.

fields.label: Sync Selection
fields.description: ERPNext decides which documents are allowed to sync. Each DocType listed here gets a per-document selector: one checkbox while a single store is connected, a list of stores once there are several.

fields.label: Catalogue DocType
fields.description: Which DocType holds your products. Item on a stock ERPNext. Changing it moves the selector onto the new DocType and tells every connected store.

fields.label: Also Under Selection
fields.description: Other DocTypes whose documents carry the selector. The catalogue is always included.
